new_grammar: EQUAL is infix between complete Course expressions; it never means warmer, later or similar.
design.two_input_consequence: COURSE_OF receives distinct Aries and Libra arguments; equality does not identify those positions. The N relation supplies a separate equality over another source pair.
design.serious_rival: The relation means SAME_PHASE or SAME_ENTITY, collapsing the paired signs; a separate physiological equal-demand family could also fit local syntax and must not be silently merged.
design.falsifier: Fail if all remaining ol occurrences cannot take SolarPosition operands, or daiin in E must become an age/person/intensity instead of the identical Course value. An equal-course clause cannot license sign identity.
design.hard_countercase: E.8 contains ol oloqorain, which commits the still-unassigned oloqorain to SolarPosition if the grammar is retained. N.4's preceding dair sheo remain unbound; W.23 is a whole line, not a whole paragraph.
